name: vint
description: AI-native vanilla TypeScript UI framework: real DOM, VanJS-shaped tag functions, Solid-faithful reactivity

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/vint.js "--banner:js=/* vint $npm_package_version — MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Robert Salesas. https://github.com/Vela-Intelligence/vint */" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && dts-bundle-generator -o dist/vint.d.ts src/index.ts --no-check --project tsconfig.build.json
